content:
Jamie: Quick heads-up — we need to reprioritize canary slots for the next 2 hours to handle an unexpected spike in v3 text-gen latency. A few details below, please read if you're owning rollouts today. :loud_sound:

Jamie: What we're changing:
- Pause new canaries for `text-gen-highmem` in us-west-2.
- Evict lower-priority experimental canaries (label: `exp/low`) to free two slots.
- Shift one canary slot to `embeddings-surge` to test caching improvements.

Jamie: Impact:
- No prod traffic will be routed to paused canaries.
- Canary checks still run for existing active canaries; only new canaries are blocked.
- If you need an exception for an enterprise rollout, ping @Release Council with justification and SLOs.

Jamie: Action items for owners:
- If you own `text-gen-highmem`, abort pending canary assignments and requeue after 12:45 UTC.
- Check your canary metric gap: `p50` p95 p99 delta > 50ms -> mark for rollback.
- Run quick health check before re-enqueue: `curl -s https://int-metrics.redwood.internal/canary/status?service=<svc>`

Sophia: Jamie — what's the exact rollback threshold for this run? We saw p95 jump ~80ms on one run.

Jamie: Sophia — for this event use conservative thresholds: p50 +40ms, p95 +60ms, p99 +90ms. If p95 breach >60ms for 3 consecutive windows (1m windows) trigger auto-rollback.

Leo: Where can I see which canaries are labeled `exp/low`? I have a few that look like that but not sure.

Jamie: Leo — `./ops/tools/canaryctl list --label exp/low` should show them. Example:
```
# list low-priority canaries
./ops/tools/canaryctl list --label exp/low --region us-west-2
```
If you don't have perms, @Release Council can grant short-lived access.

deploy-bot: Canary slot reassignment executed by ops-scheduler at 12:07 UTC — 2 slots freed in us-west-2, embeddings-surge assigned to slot 3. (run-id: a1f7c9) :robot_face:

Release Council: Thanks for the quick pivot — ops team said the eviction was clean, no customer-facing errors seen. Reminder: document any canary exceptions in the rollout ticket for postmortem.

Jamie: TL;DR: don't start new canaries for text-gen-highmem in us-west-2 for the next 2 hours, owners follow thresholds above, exceptions via @Release Council. Will post a short update when we lift the pause. :eyes:
